# Vendored Source — tasklib

This subtree is a **frozen** drop of the upstream third-party Python library
`tasklib`, which wraps the Taskwarrior CLI. Do not modify any `.py` file
under `tasklib/`. Re-sync by replacing the subtree from the upstream repo at
a newly-pinned commit.

- Upstream: https://github.com/GothenburgBitFactory/tasklib
- Commit:   `793a86d2432d93425e36a6384db1f563be07018c`
- Version:  `2.5.1`
- Vendored: 2026-04-19

## Why vendored

The ADHD assistant's `TaskwarriorStore` (task 16-01) uses tasklib to talk to
the Taskwarrior CLI. Pinning the library in-tree follows the repo's
"lift code, don't re-implement" rule and guarantees reproducible behaviour
across Mac and Windows without depending on PyPI availability.

Downstream consumers:

- `taskwarrior_store.py` — backend class wrapping tasklib's `TaskWarrior`.
- Future sub-02 will add a feature-flagged factory.
- Future sub-03 will add the syncall integration.

## Stripped from the drop

The following upstream directories and files are intentionally absent and
must stay absent (they confuse the outer repo or conflict with tooling):

- `.git/`            — upstream git metadata
- `.github/`         — upstream CI workflows (absent in reference clone)
- `docs/`            — Sphinx docs tree (~100 KB, not consumed at runtime)
- `AUTHORS`          — upstream author list (not code)
- `tasklib/tests.py` — 1726-line upstream doctest/pytest suite; would be
  collected by this repo's pytest run and pollute test counts

Kept: `LICENSE`, `README.rst`, `setup.py`, `MANIFEST.in`, and every
`tasklib/*.py` file that the public API imports transitively
(`__init__.py`, `backends.py`, `filters.py`, `lazy.py`, `serializing.py`,
`task.py`).

## Install

Added to `requirements.txt` as a non-editable path install:

```
./vendor/tasklib
```

Non-editable avoids the PEP 660 editable-install fragility that path-based
`-e` installs hit under certain pip versions on Windows.

## Build artefacts (gitignored)

- `vendor/tasklib/*.egg-info/` — pip metadata from the path install
- `vendor/tasklib/build/`      — setuptools build output
